declarations.description:
Scroll wheels to pick a value, like the pickers of iOS (the time, a timer, Health's height and weight) and the value
pickers of MyFitnessPal and Strava: each wheel is a column of rows that scrolls and snaps, and the row in the band
across the middle is its value.

`columns` lists the wheels, each with its `options` (strings, or `{ value, label?, disabled? }`), a `label` that
names it and a fixed `suffix` shown after it ("ft", "kg"); `options` alone is the shorthand for one wheel. `value`
holds one value per wheel (as an attribute, separated by `;`). A wheel without a value starts on its first enabled
row, so the picker always has a value.

Scrolling, a swipe or the mouse wheel moves a wheel; the row it settles on becomes its value and fires `input` then
`change`. Clicking a row brings it to the band. A disabled row is skipped. Setting `value` turns the wheels without
firing events. How many rows show, their height and the band are CSS (`--c2-wheel-picker--visible-rows`, …).

Each wheel is a spin button: Up and Down step a row, Page Up and Page Down five, Home and End go to the ends. It is a
form control: under a `name` the form receives the values joined by `;`, and it takes part in `c2-form-field`.
declarations.name: WheelPicker

members.name: columns
members.description: The wheels. As an attribute, a JSON array of `{ options, label?, suffix? }`.

members.name: options
members.description: Shorthand for a single wheel's options: a JSON array, or a `;`-separated list.

members.name: value
members.description: One value per wheel. As an attribute, a `;`-separated list. Not reflected: the attribute stays as the author wrote it.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives the values joined by `;`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the wheels off; as for a disabled form control, the value is not submitted.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the picker. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: steering
members.description: Wheels being turned from code: their scroll does not count as the user's.

members.name: gliding
members.description: Wheels already scrolling, smoothly, to the value just chosen: their scroll is not cut short by a jump.

members.name: resizeObserver
members.description: A picker rendered while hidden (a closed sheet, a tab) has no scroll position yet: it turns its wheels once it has a size.

members.name: dragging
members.description: Where `scrollend` is missing, a pointer still down holds the wheel: the settle timer only runs after it lifts.

members.name: nearestEnabled
members.description: The enabled row nearest to `index` (itself when enabled), or -1 when the wheel has none.

members.name: turnToValue
members.description: Scrolls every wheel to its value, without firing events.

members.name: choose
members.description: Sets one wheel's value as the user's choice: fires `input` then `change`.

members.name: settle
members.description: The row a wheel came to rest on becomes its value; a disabled one hands over to the nearest enabled row.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the user turns a wheel to another row, before `change`. Read `value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user turns a wheel to another row. Not fired for programmatic changes.
